# MathJax 3.2.2

The workbook ships the official combined TeX and MathML input / SVG output component, unchanged, for offline reading. The upstream Apache License 2.0 accompanies the component in this directory. [MathJax release source](https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax/blob/3.2.2/es5/tex-mml-svg.js) · [Component documentation](https://docs.mathjax.org/en/v3.2/web/components/combined.html#tex-mml-svg)
